Bloomberg.t: Japanese Stocks Mixed on Domestic Earnings, Ahead of US Midterms
Bloomberg.tt: Japon Hisse Senetleri, Kioxia'nın Kâr Görünümü Olan Teknoloji Satışları Nedeniyle Düştü
Bloomberg.s: Japanese stocks were mixed, with investors assessing individual earnings in Japan while remaining on the sidelines as they await the US midterm elections this week.
Bloomberg.ss: Japon hisseleri, teknoloji hisselerinin ABD'deki sert satışlardan darbe almasıyla düşerken, çip üreticisi Kioxia Holdings Corp. da hayal kırıklığı yaratan bir kâr görünümünün ardından düşmeye hazırlanıyordu.

Bloomberg.t: Most Asian Stocks Rise With US Futures, Oil Falls: Markets Wrap
Bloomberg.tt: Asya Hisse Senetleri, Tech Rout'un Yapay Zeka Korkularını Artırmasıyla Düşecek: Piyasalar Sarılıyor
Bloomberg.s: Most Asian stocks rose with US equity futures as investors recovered their risk appetite following last week’s slump in tech shares. Oil fell.
Bloomberg.ss: Asya hisse senetleri, teknoloji hisselerindeki sert düşüşün yapay zekadaki yükselişin çok ileri gitmiş olabileceği yönündeki endişeleri derinleştirmesi nedeniyle Cuma günkü Wall Street'teki sert satışın ardından düşmeye hazırlanıyor.

Bloomberg.t: Reliance Shares Hit Nine-Month High as Iran War Boosts Refining
Bloomberg.s: Shares of Reliance Industries Ltd. rallied the most in nine months after earnings from India’s most valuable company beat analyst estimates, driven by a strong performance in its oil-to-chemicals business.

Bloomberg.t: Tokyo, Chubu Power Price Hit Multi-Year High as Fuel Costs Climb
Bloomberg.s: Japan’s spot power prices surged at the weekend, with elevated fuel costs driving rates in major electricity-consuming regions Tokyo and Chubu to multi-year highs.

Bloomberg.t: Citi Cuts Lithium Forecasts on Worsening Battery Demand Outlook
Bloomberg.s: Citigroup Inc. cut its price targets for lithium for the next two years, citing concerns over a slowdown in battery demand growth, rising trade uncertainty and broader macroeconomic headwinds.

Bloomberg.t: Chinese Steel Group Chides Mills for Ignoring Output Curb Calls
Bloomberg.s: Some Chinese steel mills have ignored calls to curb output and reduce inventories, leaving the sector oversupplied and struggling for profitability, according to a commentary published by the industry’s main association.

Bloomberg.t: Emerging-Market FX Slips as Traders Await Iran Progress, US Data
Bloomberg.s: Emerging-market currencies fell as investors weighed lingering Middle East tensions and awaited US economic data later this week.

Bloomberg.t: Coal India Unit South Eastern Coalfields Files for India IPO
Bloomberg.s: South Eastern Coalfields Ltd., a unit of state-run Coal India Ltd., has filed a draft prospectus with India’s markets regulator for an initial public offering.

Bloomberg.t: Indonesia Court Voids VP’s High-School Equivalency Certificate
Bloomberg.s: Indonesia’s Supreme Court invalidated a high-school equivalency certificate submitted by Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka as part of his candidacy in the 2024 election, raising questions about his ability to remain in office or run again in 2029.

Bloomberg.t: Gold Climbs Back From One-Year Low as Dip Buyers Arrest Slide
Bloomberg.s: Gold rose, as lower oil prices offered some respite from inflationary pressures and dip buyers were drawn by the metal’s slide Friday to the lowest in a year.
